description:
Free, private, all-in-one personal organizer. Self-hostable. solyto is a free, private, all-in-one personal management app — covering your todos, contacts, calendar, notes, news, music and book library in one place, with one login, and one coherent interface. Connect to your own self-hosted solyto instance or use solyto.app. Features
  • Todos with one-line creation and short commands
  • Calendar with DAV sync
  • Contacts with DAV sync
  • Notebook — folders, markdown, WYSIWYG editor
  • News reader
  • Music, Book, Game, Recipe, Quote and Link libraries
  • Check In — track your mood and health
  • Time Tracking with Pomodoro Timer
  • Finance Tracking — income and wealth
  • Clipboard — copy things across devices
  • Dashboard combining all your data
  • Multiple themes including Skyrim, paper, and Atari
Highlights
  • Import music from Deezer or Discogs, books from Hardcover or Goodreads
  • Get notified about new releases from favorite artists or authors
  • Automatically save links via Telegram Bot
  • Daily digest notifications via Telegram, Email or Push
Privacy No tracking, no analytics, no cookies, no AI, no subscriptions. Most external services (Deezer, Discogs, Hardcover, Goodreads, Telegram, etc.) are only contacted when you explicitly request it. Weather city search queries OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service (nominatim.openstreetmap.org) directly from your device to look up locations as you type.
